openingPlan.title: Causal contact staging
openingPlan.baselineOpportunity: Baseline labels do not specify simultaneous target and actual attachment visibility.
openingPlan.proposedVisualConsequence: Keep intended and actual contact participants in one readable frame; clarity remains a hypothesis.
openingPlan.materialDifference: Adds source-bound simultaneous causal staging, rather than a closer framing adjective.
risksReducedHypotheses: Explicit visibility may reduce causal ambiguity.
unknowns: Clarity and generator feasibility require rendered visual evidence.

escalationPlan.materialDifference: Adds exact action/consequence pairing and explicit ordered state holds, rather than timestamp labels.
